verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a cloud email client that stores user mail on its own servers, so the axis applies. The pack contains no first-party documentation of choosing a storage region or residency. The only related item is a community comment that Superhuman stores all emails on its servers, which says nothing about where or whether users can choose.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
